file.name: lib.rs

graph.invariants: SplitMix64 deterministic PRNG; Safe-First-Click relocation; 64-bit u64 masks

file.summary: Implements the allocation-free (#![no_std]) 8x8 Minesweeper state machine over flat u64 bitboards (mine_mask, revealed_mask, flagged_mask, detonated_mask). Board generation uses an embedded SplitMix64 PRNG so any 64-bit seed produces byte-identical mine layouts across native x86/ARM and wasm32 targets.
file.architecture: Serves as the ground-truth simulation kernel for both the wasm-fb Mines appliance app and the downstream reinforcement learning pipeline. Exposes get_observation() and get_action_mask() as flat [f32; 64] tensors for direct policy network evaluation.

file.name: Cargo.toml

graph.invariants: Zero runtime dependencies; single no_std library target

file.summary: Declares the package metadata, edition, license, and library root for the mines-sm crate. Pinpoints zero runtime dependencies to ensure pristine #![no_std] compilation and near-instant compile times across embedded and WebAssembly targets.
file.architecture: Defines the compilation boundary of the standalone Mines state machine crate, enabling independent unit testing, RL agent binding, or direct vendoring into appliance environments.
